text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby shines with supreme radiance. 
Seeing her light, her mother whispered 
with pride that she had found the new 
symbol of the "Splendid Clan."

Every spectator welcomed Daiichi Ruby with 
respect. Her rivals praised her valiant 
effort, and her mother applauded in 
admiration as well.

Daiichi Ruby declares before the packed 
crowd that through her running, she will 
continue to shine as the new symbol of the 
"Illustrious Clan"—
